moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: nationwide dealer, distributor and OEM network — evidence: 875+ dealers/distributors, 30+ OEM partnerships, 10+ warehouses and 8 service centres, covering over 1,300 pin codes.
- technology: in-house R&D department supporting product/quality improvement and process technology development — evidence: R&D capital expenditure of ₹73.60 Lakhs and an in-house Research and Development Department carrying out product and quality improvement, new designs and process-technology development.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Manufacturing depends on lithium-ion cells, electronic components and other inputs whose prices and availability may fluctuate; changes in commodity prices, supplier pricing, freight and import-related costs may affect margins and working capital.
- Dependence on global suppliers and imported components exposes the Company to geopolitical events, logistics disruptions, trade restrictions, currency movements and changes in customs duties.
- Battery technology is rapidly evolving (chemistry, BMS, thermal management, charging, energy-storage architecture); technological obsolescence may affect product competitiveness.
- Subject to evolving EV, battery safety, environmental, recycling and other regulatory requirements; changes in standards or policy incentives may affect product design, costs or market demand.
- Battery industry is characterised by increasing competition from established domestic and international players, which may pressure pricing, market share, product innovation and margins.
- Rapid growth may increase requirements for inventory, trade receivables and other working capital; expansion and capital expenditure may also increase financing requirements.
- To the extent the Company imports cells/components or undertakes foreign-currency transactions, fluctuations in exchange rates may affect procurement costs and profitability.
- Dependence on a limited number of major customers or suppliers, if material, may increase business continuity and pricing risks.
